material.description: pages.yml 'Lay out the site' step: cp -r js/client _site/js/client; scripts/dev/stage.sh does the same. Symptom: deploy artifact, compare.mjs walk and first-draw site carry files no page imports (wireweave/node_modules/nostr-tools .map files, tests). Acceptance: the layout step prunes everything check-modulepreload.mjs does not reach plus dynamic-import targets, artifact size drops, and compare.mjs plus first-draw still pass. Witness: du of _site before and after in the pages log.
material.subject: The Pages site copies js/client whole, including vendor/wireweave/node_modules (11 MB), wireweave site/ and unused three builds (5.7 MB)
material.witness: verify-pages-site-ships-vendor-node-modules witness RESULT: PASS; CI green on 9d6165006503 (ci 40179272561, pages 40179272563), publishes 220ec688 and 6ac10955
